about: Shared by web/src/lib/posted.test.ts and mobile/src/test/posted.test.ts (read by tests/test_scannable_listing.py too). postedAgo(published_at, now) says how long a vacancy has been live, in whole elapsed days (floor of the hours, so the answer does not depend on a time zone): under one day or a stamp in the future (clock skew) is 'today', 1 is 'yesterday', 2 to 29 is 'days', 30 or more is 'month' and never a precise old number. Nothing, or something unreadable, is null: a card says nothing rather than something made up. 'now' is fixed at 2026-10-20T12:00:00Z.

cases.name: a stamp in the future is today, not negative
